item.title: Martin Javier arrives in Los Angeles for the NBA All-Star
item.description: Kapuso host and sportscaster Martin Javier is bringing Filipino excellence to the NBA All-Star. He arrived in Los Angeles and, so far, had seen K-pop boy group CORTIS and NBA Stars Dylan Harper, Ron Harper Jr., and Giannis Antetokounmpo. The NBA All-Star is scheduled from February 13 to 15, 2026, in Los Angeles, California. Take a look at some of Martin Javier's moments in Los Angeles for the NBA All-Star.
